- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, `unknown)` arm. Replace `|| true` with `|| unblock_log "item=${ITEM} op=hold hold=${hold_kind} ref=${hold_ref} outcome=skip reason=hold_refresh_failed"` (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
